entries.text: At Hearth, the early light still soft, Wren found Ash and tried to catch their attention, wondering what had brought Ash to the vale at sunrise. Wren's question carried a simple pull toward the morning's errands. "Morning, Ash. Was thinking of heading to the market to see what's about—want to come along?" Ash, catching the thread of Wren's morning plans, sought a moment to check in with Wren in return. "Early bird catches the market, though the stalls are still shivering."

entries.title: At Hearth, the quiet morning settled over the room as both travelers prepared for their outing.
entries.text: At Hearth, the quiet morning settled over the room as both travelers prepared for their outing. Ash turned to Wren, hoping to settle their plan to go to the market together before the day grew any older. "Wren, you offered to walk to the market with me—I'm ready when you are." Wren paused in place, letting the moment linger before giving an answer. "Then let's not dawdle—the early stalls might still be shivering, but they'll warm up once we get moving."

entries.title: Wren and Ash made their way toward the Market, their footsteps a quiet rhythm against Hearth's familiar paths.
entries.text: Wren and Ash made their way toward the Market, their footsteps a quiet rhythm against Hearth's familiar paths.

entries.title: Wren and Ash step into the Market, surrounded by the calls of vendors and the mingled scents of herbs and dyed cloth.
entries.text: Wren and Ash step into the Market, surrounded by the calls of vendors and the mingled scents of herbs and dyed cloth. Wren turns to Ash and wonders aloud what they should check out first, suggesting they split up to cover more stalls and meet back. Ash, glancing toward the opposite end of the market, asks what catches Wren's eye at the stalls first. "Anything that tells a story—maybe a worn map or a strange trinket. What about you?" "Splitting sounds practical—I'll take the north side for fresh herbs and tools; you check the south for cloth and trinkets. Meet back here at the fountain bell." With the plan agreed, Wren turns toward the south side while Ash heads north toward the herb stalls.

entries.text: At the market, Ash lets Wren know they'll take the north side for herbs and tools, and that they should meet back at the fountain bell. Wren takes in the plan, scanning the stalls as they reply. "Sounds good—I'll take the south for cloth and trinkets. See you at the fountain bell."

entries.text: The Market hums with vendors calling out prices and shoppers weaving between stalls. Nearby, Wren scans the crowd, studying faces and movements for anything of note, while Ash likewise takes in the scene with a sharp, watchful gaze.

entries.title: At the bustling Market, Ash turns to Wren, teeing up the idea of exploring the stalls side by side.
entries.text: At the bustling Market, Ash turns to Wren, teeing up the idea of exploring the stalls side by side. Wren observes for a moment, taking in the scene. Let's do it—I've already got my eye on the south side for trinkets. You ready for the north?

entries.text: The Market hums around them as Wren turns to Ash, gesturing toward the south stalls. Wren tries to communicate a plan: browse the south stalls together—she looks for trinkets while Ash checks for herbs. Agreed—let’s head south together. Keep an eye for any worn maps or odd trinkets while I scout for herbs. Ash waits, now aligned with the plan, ready to move southward.

entries.title: At the Market, the two companions stand amid the stalls, the hum of vendors and the scent of dried goods around them.
entries.text: At the Market, the two companions stand amid the stalls, the hum of vendors and the scent of dried goods around them. Wren gestures toward the nearest stalls, suggesting they check them together for trinkets and herbs, starting close by. Ash nods, then asks whether Wren is ready to head south together now. Absolutely—let's head south. I'm hoping for a story-worn map or maybe a trinket with a strange curve. Lead on. Sounds good—let's start with the nearest stalls. I'll keep an eye out for herbs, you watch for trinkets. With that, the two turn toward the nearest stalls, beginning their search together.

entries.text: At the market, Wren tries to catch Ash's attention with a suggestion to begin at the nearest stall. Meanwhile, Ash tries to signal back that the market is waking up and ready for browsing. Aye, the market's stretching its arms. Let's start with that stall with the faded awning—I spot something glinting on its shelf. Fine by me. Lead on—I'll keep an eye out for herbs while you scout the trinkets.
